INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SCDraw_Depths_Mark
CONSTRAINT SCDraw_Depths_Budget
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE

wrapper.name: SCDraw_Depths
wrapper.text:
---- MODULE SCDraw_Depths ----
EXTENDS Depths
LOCAL INSTANCE Naturals
SCDraw_Depths_TLC == INSTANCE TLC
SCDraw_Depths_Budget == SCDraw_Depths_TLC!TLCGet("distinct") <= 500
SCDraw_Depths_Broken == (IF SumUnderFive THEN {} ELSE {"SumUnderFive"}) \cup (IF AUnderTwo THEN {} ELSE {"AUnderTwo"}) \cup (IF BUnderTwo THEN {} ELSE {"BUnderTwo"}) \cup (IF NotBothOne THEN {} ELSE {"NotBothOne"})
SCDraw_Depths_Mark == IF SCDraw_Depths_Broken = {} THEN TRUE ELSE SCDraw_Depths_TLC!PrintT(<<"00000000000000000000000000000000", <<a, b>>, SCDraw_Depths_Broken>>)
====
